## Scrub

**Removes your location and phone details from photos before you share them.** The picture itself stays the same, including its rotation and colours.

- Works with JPEG and HEIC photos.
- Choose how it works, and which apps to skip, in Settings → Scrub.

- **iOS 15 to 27.** Rootless and RootHide jailbreaks.
- Tested on an iPhone 8 Plus (iOS 16.7). It also runs on an iPhone SE 2nd gen (iOS 17.5.1), where removing the location wasn't checked again.
- If it ever sends your phone to Safe Mode, open Sileo (it still works there) and uninstall it. Then [tell me](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).

- It works when an app uses your photo library or iOS's photo picker. Apps with their own picker may skip it: [tell me](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues) which apps work for you.
- Needs **AltList** and **PreferenceLoader**. Sileo installs them for you.
